about: Invented. Stories for what an independent review found a rule withdrawing although the conversation still said it (2026-11-24): the conversation's own day or a sign-off taken out, a date taken out while the relationship stays, a date written in words or another language, a name's spelling corrected, a name shortened to a relation, a number or a time written another way, an edit made and then undone. Phases 1 and 2 as in revision_e2e_stories.json; the last story has a third night. Every name, place and date is invented.
